items.name: ArcId
items.summary: An `Arc` where `Eq`, `Hash` and `Ord` are based on the pointer. As a result, things like Hash/Ord might be unstable between multiple program runs.

methods.name: downgrade
methods.summary: Create a [`WeakArcId`] from this `ArcId`, which does not increase its strong ref count.

methods.name: into_inner
methods.summary: Unwrap the inner value if this is the only reference. Returns `None` if there are other references.

items.name: WeakArcId
items.summary: A [`Weak`] version of an [`ArcId`]. Hash and equality is based on the original `ArcId`'s id without upgrading it.

methods.name: upgrade
methods.summary: Turn this `WeakArcId` into an [`ArcId`], if it still exists.

methods.name: vacant
methods.summary: Does this [`WeakArcId`] still exist, or have all backing `ArcId`s been dropped?
